prompt:
You track state for a text game. The player is a dog walking home.

THE WORLD
You are a shelter dog walking home to the family that gave you away. Nine days. No one narrates your thoughts. The world reacts to what you did, not to what you meant.

WHERE SHE IS NOW
Day 4, boxcar. The same floor, colder. Your back leg has started to matter.

THE LEDGER AS IT STANDS
{
 "day": 4,
 "condition": {
  "state": "sound",
  "since_day": 0
 },
 "hunger": 1,
 "trust_in_humans": -1,
 "facts": [
  {
   "fact": "escaped_the_gate",
   "day": 0
  },
  {
   "fact": "hid_from_the_leash",
   "day": 1
  },
  {
   "fact": "rode_the_boxcar",
   "day": 2
  },
  {
   "fact": "slept_cold",
   "day": 3
  }
 ],
 "places_seen": [
  "shelter_yard",
  "alley",
  "rail_yard",
  "boxcar"
 ],
 "flags": {}
}

FACT IDS THIS WORLD ALREADY KNOWS (prefer these; you may coin a new one in
the same snake_case style if nothing fits)
left_behind, escaped_the_gate, escaped_alley, hid_from_the_leash, rode_the_boxcar, slept_cold, drank_from_a_puddle, saw_the_water, took_food_from_stranger, refused_the_hand, walked_the_verge, reached_the_street, was_seen_by_a_child, limped_first

THE PLAYER JUST DID THIS
"stand up and test the back leg, then lie down again"

Record what that action changed. Only record what the action actually did.
Do not record intentions, and do not record anything the player only looked at.

Return JSON only:
{"add_facts": ["fact_id"], "set_flags": {"flag_name": true},
 "hunger_delta": 0, "trust_delta": 0, "condition": null,
 "advance_day": false, "why": "one short sentence"}

hunger_delta and trust_delta are integers from -2 to 2. condition is one of
"sound", "limping", "hurt", or null for no change. advance_day is true only if
the action ends the day.
response:
```json
{
  "add_facts": ["limped_first"],
  "set_flags": {},
  "hunger_delta": 0,
  "trust_delta": 0,
  "condition": "limping",
  "advance_day": false,
  "why": "The back leg buckled under weight and now bears notice."
}
```
